> **Mac and Android come at the beginning of next month.** Both packages will be added at the start of December.

## Sharper text and icons

- **Clean, readable text.** The HD pack's fonts were AI upscales: wobbly letter edges, uneven strokes, smeared small letters. Menu and in-game text (menus, scoreboard, pause screen, team names) is now drawn again from the game's own fonts at high resolution, with crisp, even letters.
- **The PS2 controller icon looks like a controller again.** The pack had smoothed away its d-pad, sticks and buttons; it is now the game's own drawing, enlarged with a crisp outline. Other detailed small icons get the same treatment.
- Logos keep the HD pack's look from v1.6. Your own replacement textures are never touched.
- All of it is under **Settings → Textures → Sharp text & logos** (on by default).

## Android (for testers now)

- **Crash reports:** if the game crashes, where it happened is written into the game log ("Send the last game log" on the setup screen sends it).
- **Fewer crashes in the menus:** phones are kept to settings their memory can hold (up to 2× resolution and 2× HD upscaling), and the enhanced textures use at most an eighth of the phone's memory.
- Settings that did nothing on a phone (window and monitor options, other graphics APIs, desktop updates, music import) are hidden.

## Updating

- **From v1.4.2 or later:** choose **Install** in the launcher when v1.6.1 appears, then **Restart**.
- **From v1.4.1 or earlier:** download the package for your system under **Assets** and extract it.

Your disc, saves, settings and installed packs stay where they are.
